findings.detail: The v3 evidence lock resolves 56 exact evidence references through two independently reviewed receipts; the current lock hash and receipt file hashes match.
The release is strict because it changes evidence and contains binding claims and legal interpretation; the preview classified no fast-lane path.
The deterministic integration preview is valid for exactly six UPDATE notes, with one file to write and 109 notes after integration.
The candidate changes only the six declared future-vault overlays; it adds no IDs, questions, taxonomy changes, path moves or contract changes, and no active vault or source file was modified.
Evidence dates and current-law currency remain unknown and must be checked by the human approver before publication.
Two SRC-0021 units remain excluded pending an authorised visual review; the candidate does not rely on them.
The hash-bound approval file remains PENDING. This review prepares the candidate and does not grant knowledge approval or perform integration.
